One portfolio. One capacity budget.

Award 25 non-overlapping renewal lots together, then inspect the shared constraints.

Capacity and risk assumptions

Each supplier has one budget per year and unit of measure. Budgets use the observed peak trailing-year quarter × 4; projected demand uses bounded year-over-year purchase growth. These are synthetic renewal-planning proxies, not confirmed free supplier capacity. The risk penalty is a preference parameter, separate from cash cost.

Portfolio award and cash-cost bridge

An infeasible or unproven solve returns no savings. Individual awards cannot consume the same shared capacity twice.

Where capacity binds

Inspect the tightest supplier budgets. Units remain separate.

Warehouse publication and review priorities

Off-contract spend identifies purchases for review. It is not a forecast of recoverable savings and is not added to the sourcing scenario. The normalized database, correction/deletion history and 36 monthly Parquet partitions can be regenerated locally.
